response: As part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for... This is a vital push to confront the structural inequalities that allow easy weapon modifications to fuel violence in our most vulnerable communities. For too long, the gun industry has exploited weak standards rooted in historical power imbalances, leaving marginalized groups and working people to bear the deadly costs. These reforms are needed to prioritize safety and accountability over corporate interests, protecting those hit hardest by systemic failures in public safety.
